s.note: Mr Freeze turning everything to ice
s.how: Pile crushed ice onto a platter and arrange 500g cooked prawns on top. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 2 tbsp tomato sauce, a squeeze of lemon and a dash of hot sauce. Serve in a small bowl in the middle. Everybody chill.

Separate baby cos lettuce into small cups. Toss pea shoots, sliced cucumber and mint with lemon juice and a little honey and olive oil. Spoon into the cups and crumble feta over the top. Green, leafy and only slightly dangerous.

m.note: looking after Alfred when he falls ill
m.how: Simmer 600g chicken thighs with 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks and an onion in 2L water for 40 minutes. Shred the chicken back in, add 150g egg noodles and cook 5 minutes. Finish with chopped parsley and a squeeze of lemon.

w.note: Mr Freeze turning the city to ice
w.how: Crush 250g chocolate biscuits with 80g melted butter and press into a tin. Soften 1L vanilla and 1L mint ice cream and layer over the base. Freeze overnight. Top with crushed meringue nests like fresh snow just before slicing.

d.how: Blitz 1L lemonade with a drop of blue colouring, the juice of a lime and a big bag of ice in a blender until slushy. Pour into tall glasses and serve straight away with spoons and straws, frozen solid like a villain.
